FOOTNOTES

1/ General Appropriations Act funds are appropriated as an Operating Lump Sum with Special Line Items by Agency.

Operating Budget

The Baseline includes \$2,394,900 and 40.4 FTE Positions from the General Fund in FY 2027 for the operating budget. These amounts are unchanged from FY 2026.

Field Services and Grants

The Baseline includes \$66,900 and 0.5 FTE Positions from the General Fund in FY 2027 for Field Services and Grants. These amounts are unchanged from FY 2026.

Flagstaff Pioneer Museum

The Baseline includes no funding in FY 2027 for the reopening of the Flagstaff Pioneer Museum. Adjustments are as follows:

One-Time Support for Reopening Museum The Baseline includes a decrease of \$(1,079,100) from the General Fund in FY 2027 for one-time support for the reopening of the Flagstaff Pioneer Museum.

This line item supports reopening the Flagstaff Pioneer Museum. The museum has not been open on a regular basis since 2020. As of fall 2025, the museum has not reopened. A FY 2026 budget footnote allows the agency to use the \$1,079,1000 through June 30, 2028. The Baseline continues the authority for the associated 4 FTE Positions through FY 2028.

Papago Park Museum

The Baseline includes \$572,600 and 10 FTE Positions from the General Fund in FY 2027 for the operation and maintenance of the Papago Park Museum. These amounts are unchanged from FY 2026.
